components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Brass concert action that resolves to bordeaux on interaction.
components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:3.25rem;padding:.9rem 1.35rem;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius-control);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;line-height:1.1;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color var(--duration-fast) ease,background-color var(--duration-fast) ease,transform var(--duration-fast) var(--ease-stage)}.ds-button-primary{color:var(--color-ink);background:var(--color-brass)}.ds-button-primary:hover,.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{color:var(--color-paper);background:var(--color-bordeaux);transform:translateY(-2px)}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-brass);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Text Action
components.description: Quiet secondary action for dark photographic fields.
components.css: .ds-button-text{display:inline-flex;padding:.9rem 0;color:var(--color-paper);background:transparent;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,253,248,.42);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;line-height:1.1;text-decoration:none;text-transform:uppercase;transition:color var(--duration-fast) ease,border-color var(--duration-fast) ease}.ds-button-text:hover,.ds-button-text:focus-visible{color:var(--color-brass);border-bottom-color:var(--color-brass)}.ds-button-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--color-brass);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview: The shipped system feels like entering a concert hall moments before the first note: composed, expectant, and intimate despite its scale. Authentic performance photography is the principal material. The visual rhythm alternates cinematic dark fields with quiet editorial ivory fields, while architectural edges, decisive typography, and restrained accents keep the artist and performance primary.
keyCharacteristics: Authentic artist, performance, and album imagery at decisive scale.
Concert ink and programme ivory alternating as broad visual acts.
Italiana display type paired with disciplined Albert Sans support type.
Architectural, mostly square geometry with restrained physical depth.
Mobile compositions independently art-directed from desktop.
Concert discovery remains the homepage's clearest action.

rules.name: The Stage-Light Rule
rules.body: Color appears in broad, intentional fields or as one meaningful accent; it is never scattered as decoration.

rules.name: The Rare Bordeaux Rule
rules.body: Bordeaux signals a musical or conversion moment and does not become a general-purpose accent.

rules.name: The One Aria Rule
rules.body: Each viewport has one dominant typographic voice; supporting headings do not compete at the same scale.

rules.name: The Art-Directed Mobile Rule
rules.body: Desktop framing is never accepted as the mobile crop by default.

rules.name: The Physical Depth Rule
rules.body: An element receives elevation only when it behaves like a physical object above another plane.

rules.name: The Programme Edge Rule
rules.body: Containers read like pages, stages, and image frames, not floating glass bubbles.

dos: Do let real photographs, album covers, recorded music, and factual career evidence carry the story.
Do keep concert exploration the clearest homepage action without implying ticketing or booking.
Do preserve semantic headings, descriptive alt text, visible focus, useful no-motion states, and progressive enhancement.
donts: Don't use social-media gradients, neon glows, glassmorphism, or a link-in-bio visual language in the approved system.
Don't turn sections into repeated rounded cards, pills, or floating shells.
Don't apply the homepage redesign to other pages by inference; those routes remain outside this approved scope.
